g.text: A dashed amber cell repeats the previous vertex: that step is a wait action. Grey cells: the robot has arrived and stays at its goal.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: This is the MAPF solution Π the rest of the kit works with. Row = one robot's path π_R; column = one time step. It is collision-free: no column contains the

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: same vertex twice, and no two robots swap places between neighbouring columns.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
